Philippus Saxii & Hohensaxii Baro animum adiecisset, & iamiam in opus incumberet, à nepote suo crudelem in modum in convivio nihil mali suspicatus iugulatur. Quod tamen parricidium non tulit impune. Nam haut diu post Viennae comprehensus in carcere detruncatur. Muri vero ab hoc ipso Henrico exaedificati adhuc superfunt indicia castri munitissimi & tali loco digni.

main_text.p: Imo ergaparentes ductus amore) parent, cognatos, qui Alamannis eadem notionis ratione Vetter. Balbus Catholico; Parens etiam accipitur pro consanguineo vel affine. unde parentela, cognatio, consanguinitas, cogermanitas, contribulitas. Infra Cap.11. page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are largely illegible in the scan and have been omitted. Several words in the blackletter German passages (e.g., "gewonheiten", "gerechtigkeiten") are uncertain. The line "Ccc.item pondo" begins with a decorated initial, read as "Ccc." with a woodcut initial letter. The final line is partly cut and some words are doubtful.
